Title: Change Management
Description: Doctums is a leading provider of change management and consulting services specifically designed for higher education to support strategic projects and technology transformation.
Service Description 1: Doctums will help your institution focus on identifying Key Performance Indicators and methods of measurement to drive Readiness Assessments and Scorecards.
Service Description 2: A structured communication strategy and plan helps institutions develop and deliver key messaging and gather critical feedback to keep stakeholders informed and engaged.
Service Description 3: Change management's role is to support stakeholders by ensuring they understand the business case, the future state, expectations, and how they'll receive the training and resources needed for success.
Service Description 4: Training is the culmination of decisions made, new or changed policies, redesigned processes, and newly implemented technology: it is a major milestone of the project and key to the project’s success.

Title: Data Governance
Description: Doctums provides comprehensive data governance services to help higher education institutions establish or mature their data management frameworks. By fostering transparency, consistency, and collaboration, our services ensure data is a valuable and secure institutional asset.
Service Description 1: Doctums collaborates with institutions to design data governance frameworks tailored to their unique contexts, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and strategic objectives.
Service Description 2: We facilitate the creation of cross-functional data stewardship programs, empowering designated stewards to oversee data quality, access, and security across the institution.
Service Description 3: Our services help institutions establish clear data policies, procedures, and compliance measures, safeguarding data integrity and meeting regulatory requirements.
Service Description 4: Doctums assists in developing comprehensive data catalogs and glossaries, ensuring transparency and accessibility by defining data elements, their relationships, and their availability.
Service Description 5: We enable centralized data management, eliminating silos and ensuring a single source of truth for operational and reporting data, fostering consistency and informed decision-making.

Title: Executive Coaching
Description: Doctums provides tailored executive coaching services to higher education leaders, empowering them to navigate challenges, enhance leadership skills, and drive institutional success.
Service Description 1: Doctums helps leaders step back to gain a "balcony view" of their institution, offering perspective and insight to align actions with long-term goals while identifying areas of improvement and growth.
Service Description 2: Our coaching focuses on building key leadership skills, such as strategic thinking, emotional intelligence, and decision-making, enabling leaders to guide their institutions through complexity with confidence.
Service Description 3: Executive coaching fosters deeper connections between leaders and their stakeholders, encouraging collaboration, improving communication, and ensuring alignment with institutional objectives.
Service Description 4: By equipping leaders with tools to analyze challenges holistically, Doctums coaching ensures they are prepared to make informed, impactful decisions that resonate throughout their institutions.

Title: IT Governance
Description: Doctums provides tailored IT governance frameworks for higher education institutions, ensuring IT initiatives align with strategic goals, optimize performance, and mitigate risks. Our approach fosters collaboration, transparency, and innovation across the organization.
Service Description 1: We ensure IT initiatives are closely aligned with institutional goals, enabling teaching, learning, and operational excellence while driving mission-critical outcomes.
Service Description 2: Doctums develops equitable frameworks for managing IT resources, ensuring projects are proposed, approved, and funded efficiently while maximizing impact and minimizing waste.
Service Description 3: Our governance models address critical areas like regulatory compliance, security, and risk mitigation, ensuring all initiatives adhere to institutional standards.
Service Description 4: We implement structured decision-making processes with published criteria, scoring systems, and stakeholder input, fostering clarity and accountability from proposal to implementation.
Service Description 5: Our governance frameworks encourage innovation by integrating portfolios with institutional objectives and fostering collaboration among stakeholders to drive impactful, forward-thinking solutions.

Title: Portfolio Rationalization
Description: Doctums’ Portfolio Rationalization services optimize higher education IT infrastructures by streamlining technology portfolios, reducing costs, and aligning investments with institutional strategic goals.
Service Description 1: Doctums conducts a detailed evaluation of your technology assets to identify redundancies, underutilized systems, and opportunities for improvement.
Service Description 2: Our approach reduces IT expenses by eliminating unnecessary technologies and reallocating resources to high-value initiatives.
Service Description 3: We simplify technology ecosystems to improve usability for students, faculty, and staff, ensuring seamless and intuitive interactions.
Service Description 4: Doctums ensures technology investments are aligned with institutional objectives, driving academic excellence, operational efficiency, and innovation.
Service Description 5: By addressing security vulnerabilities and outdated systems, we mitigate risks while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
